input_quality_overview.quality_caveat: Global parser coverage can be misleading when raw reference input is degraded; consult per-bucket metrics before drawing integration conclusions.

recommendation.rationale: refextract was the only alternative executed end-to-end in this environment; LLM wiring is ready but no API execution happened because credentials are missing; AnyStyle is blocked by the lack of Ruby/anystyle-cli on this machine. For this stack, the most promising next real integration candidate is an LLM parser over already segmented references because it matches the desired architecture, avoids a Ruby dependency, and can return a schema tailored to CiteCheck. Refextract is useful as a bounded benchmark, but its parsing is biased toward journal-style patterns and required environment-specific shimming. AnyStyle should be deferred unless you provision a separate Ruby-capable sandbox specifically for it.
